coordinateConvention: Source mm/Z-up; client (x,y,z)=(source.x,source.z,-source.y). Mount center source XY=(0,5.5).
method: Full evaluated source triangles; actual Blender re-tessellation after vertex edits. Discrete BVH triangle intersection and three-ray signed winding witnesses. No GLB simplification or parametric proxy.

repair.seat: Two ears retain Z25.45..27.25, narrow 18 to 13 degrees, outer radius9.35 to9.30; exterior body radius7.4 to7.3. Interior spring/cap/switch surfaces unchanged.
repair.shell: Two existing lock pocket regions only: R7.3..10.5, source angles36..70 and opposite, Z21..28.5. Monotone local Z remapping raises old Z24.21236455 bearing plane to25.4500007 and lowers shoulder27.18 to26.05. Cap upper retention stop is outside edited Z range.

limitations: Witness distances are upper bounds on the true global minimum, not a positive-clearance certificate.
Discrete poses do not certify continuous collision-free motion.
Rest planar bearing contact is intentional and excluded from sliding-clearance goals.
Closed-housing assembly, spring stability, material strength, friction, and manufacturing tolerances require separate validation.

independentBearingContactReview.method: Independent source mesh triangle intersection reconstruction and 2D clipping of opposing horizontal faces; final source installation audit repeats this measurement.
